tools.name: get_pipeline_summary
tools.description: Summarize confirmed US data center pipeline, operating, and unconfirmed campus counts and disclosed vs. estimated megawatt coverage by state or stage.

tools.name: check_moratoriums
tools.description: Check active, pending, extended, and expired US city, county, and township data center moratoriums and zoning bans with status, date, and source links.

tools.name: get_metro_market
tools.description: Inspect US data center metro markets: pipeline and construction campus counts, disclosed MW, ISO region, industrial electricity rates, Sentinel-2 clearing activity, and local moratorium counts.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open US data center construction, engineering, commissioning, and operations roles by state, city, employer, or keyword.

tools.name: search_campuses
tools.description: Search US data center campuses across Pipeline, Operating, and Unconfirmed groups by name, location, stage, owner, ISO, megawatts, moratorium, or water risk. Free accounts return public fields; Wattlas Pro unlocks all campuses and deep filters.

tools.name: get_campus_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve a detailed campus dossier by campus ID (c_...) or public slug, including modular sections for grid/utility, water/energy use, backup diesel/EPA, parcel/site facts, satellite aerial vision, opposition, jobs, and cleared filings. tools.name: list_filings
tools.description: List cleared primary-source government and civic data center filings by campus ID, state, county, stage, or date range with direct official URLs (requires Wattlas Pro).

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Look up data center owners, developers, operators, or tenants and inspect their US campus portfolio, total disclosed MW, states, and corporate links (requires Wattlas Pro).

tools.name: get_campus_opposition
tools.description: Retrieve local data center opposition signals including moratorium ordinances, petitions, contested lawsuits, and community threads by campus ID, state, or county (requires Wattlas Pro).

tools.name: get_site_rankings
tools.description: Rank US data center campuses by permitted backup diesel MW, disclosed water use, WRI water stress, Sentinel-2 earthwork ahead of permit stage, pipeline MW, or rising industrial power rates (requires Wattlas Pro).
